story.alert: 18:45 · TWO MESSAGES, ONE ALLY · COMMS RELAY
story.vex: Signing your name is easy when nobody checks the signature. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The forged ally message is exposed; the real one is trusted. Astro: "A shared secret can leak. A signature only the real sender could make cannot be faked without the private key. That's the difference."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Two messages arrived claiming to be from Codexia's allies. Read both signature reports, classify each as valid or forged, then submit the id of the genuine one.

1. type message-A.txt and message-B.txt
2. classify message-A valid/forged, same for message-B
3. submit the id of the real one
files.C:\\Citadel\\message-A.txt:
MESSAGE-A
From: Codexia Allied Fleet
Body: Rendezvous confirmed at the third moon.
Signature check: signed with the Allied Fleet's public key on file. Verified.
files.C:\\Citadel\\message-B.txt:
MESSAGE-B
From: Codexia Allied Fleet
Body: Redirect to Doom-controlled coordinates immediately.
Signature check: no matching public key on file. Signature does not verify.

steps.title: Rivet's Workbench: check the signatures
steps.body: Rivet: "With public-key crypto, only the real sender's private key could make a signature that verifies against their public key. Doom doesn't have Codexia's private key, no matter how well they copy the letterhead." Read both messages, then classify each: `classify message-a valid` or `forged`, same for `message-b`.

steps.title: Trust the genuine one
steps.body: Astro: "Act only on what's actually signed." Submit the id of the genuinely signed message.
